summary: postinstall fetches and installs executable from bare IP with TLS verification disabled
details: The package's postinstall lifecycle script downloads a platform tarball from a hardcoded bare-IPv4 endpoint (https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/...) using https.get with rejectUnauthorized:false, disabling TLS certificate validation. The fetched archive is extracted, the extracted binary is chmod 0755 and hardlinked into bin/.onecode so it becomes the CLI executed by users of the package. No hash or signature verification is performed on the downloaded bytes. The destination is a bare IP unrelated to any publisher domain, is not pinned by content hash, and the transport-layer integrity check is explicitly turned off, so the operator of that IP — or any on-path attacker — can deliver arbitrary executable code that runs on the installer's machine and is placed on PATH via the package's bin entry.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
